sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Build the skeleton of your web page using core HTML tags!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Create a profile page at home using a main heading <h1>, a short paragraph description about yourself <p>, and separate the sections with a horizontal rule <hr>!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Make your pages colorful with images and navigate the web with links!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Write code at home that renders an image of your favorite hobby, followed by a link that opens a tutorial about it in a new tab!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Keep your data perfectly organized in lists and structured tables!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Create a food shopping list using an ordered list `<ol>` reversed, followed by a table displaying 3 items and their prices with a header row!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Embed sounds and movies directly into your page using HTML5!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Embed an audio element at home that loops automatically, and a video element that is muted by default with a beautiful placeholder cover poster!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Collect user input with forms, inputs, selections, and checkboxes!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Create a feedback form at home with a `<fieldset>` and `<legend>`. Include a required Name input, a drop-down list `<select>` to rate the session from 1 to 5, a `<textarea>` for suggestions, and a submit button!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Group your tags inside structural containers and style them with classes!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Build a simple blog post layout using a parent `div` with a class of 'blog-post'. Inside, put a heading with class 'blog-title' and a paragraph where the date is styled inside a `span` with an ID of 'post-date'!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Paint your website beautiful with CSS rules, selectors, and color styles!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Create a page at home with a heading styled internally using a HEX color value, and three paragraphs, each styled with a unique color class using RGB, RGBA, and standard color names!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Style your container backgrounds with colors, images, sizing, and attachments!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Style a full page background or banner division at home to have a fixed background image background-attachment: fixed; that does not scroll, centered on the screen, and sized as cover!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Control spacings with margins, padding, custom borders, and width sizes!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Design a box division at home styled with a double border of 5px size, colored in purple, with a 30px padding on the inside and a 50px margin on the bottom!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Format font-families, font weights, text alignments, capitalization, and spacings!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Design a book title display at home. Use a serif font, uppercase styling, bold text, 3px letter-spacing, and deep indigo color!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Float images next to paragraphs, clear floats, and control overflow scrolls!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Create a layout at home with an image floated to the right of a story, and place a footer paragraph underneath that uses clear: both; so it always starts on a fresh line below the image!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Master block vs inline elements, hide containers, and style links with hover effects!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Design navigation menu links at home! Display them in a line using display: inline-block;, remove lines under them, and change background and color when hovered!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Position containers (relative, fixed, absolute), add shadows, and load Font Awesome icons!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Create a glowing card at home! Include a fire icon, a text heading with an orange text-shadow glow, and styled with relative coordinates!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Bring elements to life with @keyframes, durations, delays, and loop counts!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Build an infinite loader spinning wheel at home! Create keyframes that rotate the element 360 degrees and run infinitely!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Setup the layout, navbar links, and header banner for the final Delicious Project!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Build the welcome banner for your restaurant at home! Align text in the center, style it with custom fonts, and add a Book Table button with glowing box-shadows!

sections.heading: 🌟 Core Concept
sections.text: Add food product cards (Chicken & Seafood), styling, borders, and footer details!

sections.heading: 📘 Student Homework
sections.text: Assemble all sections at home! Put together your styled navigation bar, hero banner, food product cards (chicken & seafood) with hover animations, and the Somouha, Alexandria footer. You have built a production-grade restaurant page! Excellent work! 🌟
